about: The path tracer's parameter block: float slots in this order (vectors take consecutive slots). Read by kernels.py (CUDA) and the plugin's WGSL renderer.

fields.name: INVVP
fields.about: clip -> display (world) coordinates, column-major

fields.name: VP
fields.about: world -> clip, column-major

fields.name: VOX_FROM_WORLD
fields.about: 3x4 row-major: voxel index coordinates (x fastest) from world

fields.name: WORLD_NORMAL
fields.about: 3x3 row-major: the transpose of VOX_FROM_WORLD's linear part

fields.name: DIMS
fields.about: volume size in voxels, x, y, z

fields.name: BRICK
fields.about: majorant brick size in voxels

fields.name: MGRID
fields.about: majorant grid size, x, y, z

fields.name: DENSITY
fields.about: extinction per display unit at opacity 1

fields.name: SHADE_MIX
fields.about: 0: volume scattering only .. 1: surfaces where gradients are strong

fields.name: GRAD_SCALE
fields.about: how quickly the gradient's magnitude makes a surface (per texture unit per voxel)

fields.name: ALBEDO
fields.about: scales the transfer function's colour

fields.name: LIGHT_DIR
fields.about: direction towards the key light, world, unit

fields.name: LIGHT_RGB
fields.about: key light radiance (irradiance at normal incidence)

fields.name: ENV_TOP
fields.about: environment: colour above (world "up")

fields.name: ENV_UP
fields.about: world up for the environment, unit

fields.name: BG
fields.about: background shown where primary rays leave (alpha 0: transparent)

fields.name: CLIPS
fields.about: up to 6 planes, (nx, ny, nz, d) in world: kept where n.x + d >= 0

fields.name: CROP_LO
fields.about: crop box in voxel coordinates (inclusive), x, y, z

fields.name: LABEL_FROM_WORLD
fields.about: 3x4 row-major: label voxel coordinates from world

fields.name: LABEL_MIX
fields.about: 0: the transfer function's colour .. 1: the label's colour

fields.name: STEP
fields.about: depth pass: step in voxels

fields.name: FRAME
fields.about: pass number, for the random sequence

fields.name: APERTURE
fields.about: thin lens: aperture radius in display units (0: pinhole)

fields.name: FOCUS
fields.about: thin lens: focal distance in display units

fields.name: OPAQUE_LIMIT
fields.about: depth pass: accumulated opacity where the surface is
